hero.eyebrow: AI executive assistant for your company
hero.title: Your company, understood.
hero.subtitle: DONNA connects your knowledge, tools and workflows into one intelligent workspace — so you can simply ask, and get things done.
hero.trust: Scoped access · Your data never trains a model · Revoke any connector instantly

loop.title: Ask in plain words. She handles the rest.
loop.body: No prompt craft, no dashboards to learn. DONNA reads across your mail, calendar, drive and chat as a single memory — then answers with the sources she used, so you can check her work.

points.ask: Ask the way you would ask a colleague.
points.read: She searches every connected tool at once.
points.cite: Every answer names the documents behind it.

approve.title: She anticipates. You approve.
approve.body: DONNA surfaces what matters before you ask — a renewal clashing with a flight, a reply that should have gone out yesterday. She drafts it. Nothing leaves your account until you say so.
approve.draftSubject: Re: Master services agreement — renewal window
approve.draftBody: Sarah, thanks for the heads-up. The renewal window closes on the 14th, and I'm travelling that week. Could we move the review to Thursday the 9th?

why.eyebrow: Why an assistant, not a chatbot
why.title: The difference is what happens after the answer.

context.title: She keeps the context

act.title: She closes the loop

bento.title: As discreet as a great assistant. Considerably faster.

meetings.title: Meetings, handled

trusted.eyebrow: Trusted by teams that bill by the hour

one.body: I stopped asking where things were. She already had the file open, the clause highlighted, and an answer to the question I was about to ask.
one.name: Harvey Specter

two.body: The audit log is what sold my compliance team. Every action she takes is legible after the fact. That is rarer than it should be.
two.name: Rachel Zane

three.body: She drafts in my voice well enough that I mostly press send. The hour I used to lose to my inbox is simply gone.
three.name: Louis Litt

four.body: I onboarded in an afternoon. No prompts to learn, no dashboard to configure — I just asked, the way I would ask a person.
four.name: Mike Ross

data.q: Does DONNA train on my company's data?
data.a: No. Your content is used to answer your questions and nothing else. It is never used to train a model, and it is never shared with other customers.

access.a: Only the connectors you switch on, with scoped OAuth and least-privilege permissions. You can revoke any connector at any time, and she immediately loses that access.

act.q: Can she act without asking me?
act.a: Never on anything that leaves your account. She drafts, proposes and schedules, but sending, sharing and updating always wait for your explicit approval.

wrong.q: What happens when she is wrong?
wrong.a: Every answer names the documents behind it, so you can check the source in one click. When she is unsure, she says so rather than guessing.

setup.a: Sign in with Google and connect a tool or two — most teams are asking useful questions within ten minutes. There is nothing to configure or train.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: What DONNA will and will not do with the workspace you connect.

scope.title: What she may reach
scope.body: Only the connectors you switch on, through scoped OAuth with least-privilege permissions. Revoking a connector removes her access immediately and irreversibly.

consent.title: Nothing leaves without you
consent.body: DONNA drafts, proposes and schedules. Sending, sharing and updating always wait for an explicit approval from you. There is no setting that removes this step.

audit.title: Everything is written down
audit.body: Every action taken on your behalf lands in an audit log you can read, export and hand to your compliance team.

accuracy.title: She can be wrong
accuracy.body: Every answer names the documents behind it so you can check the source. When she is unsure she says so. You remain responsible for the decisions you take.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Where your content goes, and where it does not.

training.title: Your data trains nothing
training.body: Your content answers your questions and nothing else. It is never used to train a model and never shared with other customers.

storage.title: Storage
storage.body: Encrypted at rest and in transit. Indexed content lives in your workspace and is deleted with it.

separation.title: Separation between clients
separation.body: Documents feed one general knowledge base for your company. What DONNA retains about a given client stays in that project's own memory and is not surfaced in another.

deletion.title: Removal
deletion.body: Disconnecting a connector removes its access. Deleting a project removes its memory. Deleting the workspace removes the index.
